results.title: Za mu tabbatar da wanzuwar ƴansandan jihohi kafin Disamba - Majalisar Dattijai
results.content: Majalisar Dattijan Najeriya ta bayyana yiwuwar kankamar ayyukan ƴansandan jihohi kafin ko kuma a cikin watan Disamban shekarar nan, lamarin da ke kawo ƙarshen doguwar muhawar gomman shekaru kan fatan samar da rundunar ƙarƙashin ikon jihohi.

results.title: Kurdawa na samun nasara a kan mayakan ISIS a Syria
results.content: Dubban yan gudun hijira na ci gaba da tserewa fadan da ake tabkawa tsakanin Kurdawa da mayakan Jihadin kungiyar Isis a kasar Syriya al'amarin da ya haifar da kwararar 'yan gudun hijira a kasar Turkiya.

results.title: An samu raguwar kona motoci a bikin sabuwar shekara a Faransa
results.content: Gwamnatin Faransa tace an samu raguwar yawan adadin motocin da ake konewa a lokacin bikin sabuwar shekara da kashi 12 cikin 100 a cikin kasar. alkalumma sun nuna cewa a jajibirin sabuwar shekara an kone motoci 940 sabanin 1,067, da aka cinna wa wuta a shekarar da ta gabata.

results.title: Rasha da Afrika sun kammala taronsu kan tsaro da samar da abinci a nahiyar
results.content: An kammala taron Afirka da Rasha wanda ya gudana a birnin Moscow ƙarƙashin jagorancin Vladimir Putin tare da halartar shugabanni 45 daga nahiyar Afirka.

results.title: Kotun Duniya ta bukaci Afirka ta Kudu ta cafke El-Bashir
results.content: Kotun hukunta manyan laifufuka a duniya ICC ko kuma CPI ta bukaci hukumomin kasar Afirka ta kudu da su kama shugaban Sudan Umar Hasan El-bashir wanda ke halarar taron shugabannin Afirka yanzu haka a birnin Johannesburg.

results.title: An cafke mutane da dama kan zargin juyin mulki a Gambia
results.content: An cafke mutane da dama, da ake zargi suna da hannu a yunkurin jurin juyin mulkin da aka yi a kasar Gambia, lokacin da shugaban kasa Yahya Jammeh ke ziyara a birnin Dubai, wanda kuma ya dora alhakin harin kan ‘yan kasashen waje da bai bayyana sunayen su ba.

results.title: Ghana ta yiwa ma'aikata ƙarin albashi bayan kai ruwa rana da ƴan ƙwadago
results.content: Bayan share tsawon lokaci ana tattaunawa tsakaninta da wakilan ƙungiyoyin ƙwadago, daga ƙarshe gwamnatin Ghana ta amince ta yi wa ma’aikatan ƙasar ƙarin albashi na kashi 9% cikin 100 wanda zai fara aiki a farkon shekara mai zuwa.

results.title: Ambaliyar Ruwan sama ta yi sanadiyar mutuwar mutane 12 a Jojiya
results.content: yanzu haka dai masu kula da namun daji na ci gaba da farautar namun daji a tsakkiyar birnin Tbilissi na kasar Jojiya, bayan da ambaliyar Ruwan sama da aka sheka a birnin ta rusa gidan namun dajin da a halin yanzu suka fantsama a cikin gari

results.title: Ana ci gaba da aikin neman tarkacen jirgin AirAsia
results.content: Yau Juma’a masu aiki neman sassan jirgin saman da ya yi hadari a kan tekun Java na kasar Indonesia, sun ci gaba da aikin, kuma suna gab da kaiwa inda lamarin ya faru. An dakatar da aikin neman Jirgin ne saboda matsalar Yanayi a tekun Indonesia

results.title: Human Right Watch ta buƙaci mahukuntan Nijar su gaggauta sakin Moussa Kaka
results.content: A jiya alhamis ne ƙungiyar kare hakokin bil Adam ta Human Rights Watch ta sake jadada matsayinta kan ci gaba da tsare dan jarida a ƙasar Nijar Moussa Kaka,wanda ta bukaci majalisar sojin ƙasar ta gaggauta sako shi.

results.title: Taron Kungiyar Tarayyar Afirka karo na 25
results.content: A yau lahadi ake buda taron shugabannin kasashen kungiyar Tarayyar Afirka karo na 25 a birnin Jonnesburg na kasar Afirka ta Kudu, taron da zai mayar da hankali kan batutuwa da dama da suka shafi kasashen nahiyar.

results.title: Jami’an Italiya sun yi kokarin ceto jirgin ruwan Bakin haure
results.content: Jami’an kula da jiragen ruwa a kasar Italiya sun nasarar ceto wani jirgin ruwa da ya samu matsala a tsakiyar teku shake da bakin haure kimanin 450 bayan sun yi nasarar ceto rayuwan bakin haure da dama a cikin kwanaki biyu da suka gabata.

results.title: Najeriya ta yi ƙarin haske game da yarjejeniyar ma'adinai da Amurka
results.content: Gwamnatin Najeriya ta ce babu wata kadarar ƙasar da aka sayarwa Amurka, a ƙarƙashin yarjejeniyar da ta ƙulla na cinikin ma’adinai da ya kai Dala biliyan 700 a tsakanin su.

results.title: Kotu ba ta amince da tsige shugaba Rajoanarimampianina ba
results.content: Kotun kolin kasar Madagascar ta yi watsi da matakin tsige shugaban kasar Hery Rajoana-rimampianina da majalisar dokokin kasar ta yi a ranar 26 ga watan jiya.

results.title: An sake zabar Netanyahu a matsayin shugaban Jam’iyya mai mulki
results.content: An sake zabar Fraiministan kasar Isra’ila Benjamin Netanyahu, a matsayin shugaban jam’iyyar Likud mai mulkin kasar, a wani zaben fitar da gwanin da aka yi jiya Alhamis. Zaben na zuwa ne a daidai lokacin da ake shirin yin wani zaben gaggawa a kasar, inda ya kayar da abokin takarar shi Danny Danon mai ra’ayin gurguzu.

results.title: AU ta amince da cibiyar yaƙi da rashawa ta Najeriya a matsayin ta Afrika baki ɗaya
results.content: Kungiyar Tarayyar Afrika ta amince da Cibiyar Yaƙi da Ta'addanci ta Kasa da ke Najeriya, a ƙarƙashin ofishin mai bai wa shugaban ƙasar shawarara a fannin tsaro, a matsayin babbar cibiyar samar da ƙwarewa wajen yaƙi da ta'addanci a yankin yammacin Afrika da yankin Sahel. Wannan na zuwa ne bayan gudanar da bincike kan yadda cibiyar ke gudanar da ayyukanta da tsarin samar da horo na zamani, tare da kiyaye hakkin dan adam.

results.title: Sarkozy ya soki kawance da ke fada da mayakan IS
results.content: Tsohon shugaban Faransa Nicolas Sarkozy ya yi kakkausar ga kawancen dakarun kasashen duniya a karkashin jagorancin Amurka, dangane da yadda ya kasa murkushe mayakan da ke da’awar jihadi a kasashen Syria da Iraki.

results.title: Kotu ta fara tuhumar maharin makon jiya kan unguwar Musulmi da baƙi a Faransa
results.content: Wani ɗan bindiga da jami’an tsaro suka cafke bayan ya bude wuta tare da kashe mutum daya da kuma raunata wasu 7 a wata unguwa da ke wajen birnin Paris na Faransa, ya bayyana wa masu bincike cewa babbar manufarsa ita ce ‘’ Kai hari kan musulmi, da ƴan Afrika da kuma ƴan asalin yankin Arewacin Afirka’’.

results.title: Hillary na gudanar da yakin neman zaben shugabancin Amurka
results.content: Tsohuwar sakatariyar harkokin wajen Amurka Hillary Clinton ta kaddamar da yakin neman zabenta na neman tsayawa takarar shugabancin Amurka a jiya asabar, inda ta ce tana fatar kasancewar mace ta farko da za ta jagoranci kasar a tarihi.

results.title: Amurka ta gurfanar da wani ɗan Najeriya da ta kama da laifin satar dala miliyan 100
results.content: Amurka ta gurfanar da wani ɗan Najeriya mai suna Akinade Raheem, don fuskantar tuhume-tuhumen da ake masa na shirya zamba ta hanyar haraji, wanda ya shafi neman a dawo da sama da dala miliyan 100 da ya sata ta hanyar yaudara. ‎

results.title: RFI Hausa zai sauya Shafinsa na Intanet
results.content: Daga 15 ga watan Yuni, hausa.rfi.fr, shafin Intanet na RFI Hausa zai sauya sabuwar fuska, mai bayar da muhimmanci kan salon yada labarai irin na rediyo da hotunan bidiyo.

results.title: Najeriya ta ware naira tiriliyan guda don biyan bashin ƴan fansho na shekaru 20
results.content: Hukumar Kula da Fansho ta Najeriya ta ɗauki hankulan jama'a a kwanan nan, bayan da Babban Daraktar hukumar, Omolola Oloworaran, ta bayyana amincewar gwamnatin tarayya na biyan basussukan fansho na shekaru da dama.

results.title: Ƙwallo 15 ya ragewa Ronaldo ya kafa tarihin zura ƙwallaye dubu 1
results.content: Tafiya na ci gaba da nisa a fatan Cristiano Ronaldo na Portugal kan kafa tarihin zura ƙwallaye dubu guda gabanin ritaya, bayan da a jiya ya yi nasarar cin ƙwallaye har 3 a kararwar Al Nassr da Al Kholood ƙarƙashin Lig ɗin Saudiya, wanda ke nuna cewa tauraron na Portugal na buƙatar ƙarin ƙwallaye 15 kaɗai don kafa wannan tarihi.

results.title: Manchester United ba ta da shirin sauya Fernandes a matsayin kyaftin - Carrick
results.content: Mai horar da ƙungiyar ƙwallon ƙafa ta Manchester United Michael Carrrick ya jaddada cewa har yanzu Bruno Farnandes ne cikakken kyaftin ɗin tawagar ba tare da tunanin sauya shi ba.

results.title: Everton ta kai wasan kwata final bayan fitar da Newcastle Uinted daga Carabao
results.content: Duk da rashin Jack Grealish a wasansu na jiya, Everton ta yi nasarar doke Newcastle United da ƙwallaye 3 da 1, nasarar da kai tsaye ta bata damar samun gurbi a wasan kwata final na gasar Carabao ko kuma kofin ƙalubale na EFL, ta yadda a wasan na gaba za ta haɗu da .

results.title: Shugaban Ghana Mahama ya ce Afirka ba ta buƙatar agaji
results.content: Shugaban ƙasar Ghana John Dramani Mahama ya bayyana cewar buƙatar su ita ce ta ganin nahiyar Afirka ta daina dogaro da agajin da take samu daga manyan ƙasashen duniya, da kuma kawo ƙarshen yadda ake kwashe ma’adinan nahiyar ana tafiya da su ƙasashen yammacin duniya.

results.title: Shugabar Bankin Turai Lagarde ta sauka daga muƙamin ta
results.content: Shugabar Bankin Ƙasashen Turai Christine Lagarde ta aje aikin ta yau alhamis, abinda ya kawo ƙarshen cece kucen da ake ra yi dangane da makomar ta, kuma wannan na zuwa ne a daidai lokacin da nahiyar Turai ta shiga wani sunƙurun matsalar tattalin arziki da rarrabuwar kawunan ƴan siyasa, musamman a ƙasar ta Faransa.

results.title: An cika shekara guda da tarzomar bayan zaɓen Tanzania
results.content: Yau ake cika shekara guda da tashin hankalin zaɓen da ya hallaka mutane 518 a ƙasar Tanzania, inda wasu da suka jikkata a lokacin da ƴan uwan waɗanda suka rasa rayukan su suka yi zaman makoki da kuma juyayin abinda ya faru.

results.title: Wa’adin daina karɓar tsoffin takardun kuɗin CFA a Yankin Afirka ta Tsakiya na dab da cika
results.content: A ranar 31 ga wannan wata na Oktoba ne wa’adin da aka bai wa jama’a na su daina karɓar wasu daga cikin tsoffin takardun kuɗin CFA a Yankin Afirka ta Tsakiya, da suka haɗa da Kamaru da Chadi da Congo Brazzaville da dai sauransu zai kawo ƙarshe, to sai dai ko bayan ƙarshen wa’adin, a nasu ɓangare, bankuna za su ci gaba da karɓar kuɗaɗen har zuwa watan Afrilun shekara mai zuwa.

results.title: Bayan tserewa zuwa Amurka, Flavio ya ce shi ne shugaban Brazil
results.content: Ɗan takaran shugaban ƙasar Brazil, Flavio Bolsonaro da ya sha kaye a hannun shugaba mai ci Inacio Lula da Silva, ya bayyana cewar shi ne halartaccen shugaban ƙasa, bayan ya tsere zuwa ƙasar Amurka.
